appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Hospital Screening Referral Volume'.
A subtitle reads 'Reported window shown in the dashboard summary'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Referral volume (thousands)' and ranges from 100 to 150, with gridlines at 10-unit intervals.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and shows tick marks for 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020.
A single orange line connects four data points, one for each year from 2017 to 2020.
The data point for 2017 is at the bottom-left of the line, at approximately 100.5 on the y-axis.
The data point for 2018 is higher than 2017, at approximately 118 on the y-axis.
The data point for 2019 is higher than 2018, at approximately 134 on the y-axis.

public_definitions: The task is to review the referral dashboard and assign the record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the full 2013-2020 utilization pattern.
The chart displays the referral history for the entire reporting window (2013-2020), but only data for 2017-2020 is shown.

The three options are: 'Assign to continued monitoring for a recent upward shift that warrants observation', 'Assign to sustained-growth follow-up for a period-wide increase in referrals', and 'Assign to decline review for a downward referral pattern'.
uncertain: The chart only shows data from 2017 to 2020, not the full 2013-2020 window required by the task. The trend shown is upward, but it is impossible to determine if this trend is sustained over the full period or if there was a downward trend earlier in the period.
